data.name: Misfit Company
data.detailed_description:
Lead a squad of misfit specialists deep behind enemy lines in a gritty, boots-on-the-ground struggle to dismantle the enemy's war machine from the inside out.

In this third-person cinematic action shooter, you are the wrench in the gears of an enemy war machine. Outmanned and outgunned, you must guide your team through a hostile landscape, facing down engines of war on land and in the air. Your mission is absolute: prevent the launch of a mechanical abomination that threatens to reshape the continent forever.

Fight Dirty. Win Fast. No Rules.


A Cinematic Experience

Experience a world brought to life through rich, handcrafted animation. The game features a distinct visual style where every frame feels like a painting in motion. From the smoke-choked skylines to the expressions of your squadmates, the art direction blends stylized aesthetics with gritty realism to create an immersive, story-first atmosphere.

Dynamic Combat

Combat is not just about taking cover—it is about momentum, impact, and lethal creativity. Master a dynamic "gun-fu" fighting system that seamlessly blends precise marksmanship with brutal close-quarters brawling.

A Cast of Misfits

From the heavy weapons expert with a death wish to the silent tactician who never misses, every member of your squad brings a unique personality and lethal skillset to the fray. You will fight for them, and they will bleed for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (Super) / AMD RX 5700-XT / Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
